'''Sanlo Raal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and leader of the mercenary group [[Raal's Regulators]].<ref name="TOR:OK" />

==Biography==
Sanlo Raal used to be a member of the [[InterStellar Regulators]], a mercenary group tasked with defending the planet [[Makeb]].<ref name="codex" /> In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates:2.0">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] bribed the leaders of the Regulators, including Raal's commanding officer, to betray their contracts and assist in a [[Conquest of Makeb|coup]] against the planetary government. Along with a small group of loyal Regulators, Sanlo seized control of a Hutt transport, rescued several Regulators who were under fire from Cartel forces, and escaped the system.<ref name="codex" />

Sanlo was later contacted by her former commanding officer. He proposed to cover up her actions from the Hutt Cartel on the condition that she assassinate a member of the [[Exchange]]. After successfully completing the mission, she formally named her band of fugitives Raal's Regulators and established their base of operations on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Benefiting from her unblemished standing with the Hutts, Raal's Regulators carried out numerous assignments for the Cartel, included guarding smuggling lanes, reclaiming Hutt property, and tracking down fugitives.<ref name="codex" />

It was during these activities that Sanlo’s small mercenary group first drew the attention of [[Heta Kol]]. As Kol began the aggressive expansion of the [[Hidden Chain]], she relied on Sanlo Raal and her network to move goods seized in Hidden Chain raids and sell them on the black market. Later, Heta assigned Raal's Regulators to locate and capture Force-sensitive individuals, who were then forcibly inducted into the Hidden Chain.<ref name="codex" />

Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates" /> following [[Jemala Ha'rangir]]'s defection, Raal was given a highly valuable and exclusive [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] contract by Kol for the capture of Jemala,<ref name="item">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Bounty Contract|Mission "On the Run"}}</ref> as well as the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] that Jemala had helped free. Raal and her crew managed to capture a number of the escaped Force-sensitives, however they couldn't capture Jemala herself due to her partner [[Ora Nem]]'s invention which allowed them to detect the [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]] that Raal's crew used. At some point, Raal and her crew were all killed by the [[Alliance Commander]], who Jemala had asked for help in exchange for giving information on Heta Kol.<ref name="TOR:OK"/>
